title: GNUSlashLinux 20261008
content:
GNUSlashLinux is an Arch-based, rolling-release Linux distribution featuring the minimalist Noctalia desktop shell on top of the niri Wayland compositor. It is designed specifically for developers and power users seeking a lean, keyboard-driven operating system. The distribution's default software set includes a GPU-accelerated Kitty terminal, the modern Helix text editor, the asynchronous Yazi terminal file manager, the privacy-focused Helium web browser, and the Zathura document viewer. GNUSlashLinux also provides several pre-configured themes and colour schemes, as well as various modern command-line tools as alternatives to classic Unix commands.
